title: Kubernetes Attack & Defend (CTF)
prereqs: Comfort with RBAC and node/docker access
description: Kubernetes as an attack surface: steal ServiceAccount tokens, escalate via over-broad RBAC, reach exposed kubelet/etcd/dashboards, exfiltrate secrets, and break out of containers — then slam it shut with NetworkPolicy, Pod Security Admission, and Kyverno/OPA policy. CKS-grade offense and defense.
